name: 1,3-benzodioxolyl-N-ethylbutanamine
summary: EBDB, also known as 1,3-benzodioxolyl-N-ethylbutanamine, 3,4-methylenedioxy-α,N-diethylphenethylamine, or ethyl-J, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and MDxx families. It is the N-ethyl analogue of BDB (J) and the α-ethyl analogue of MDEA.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the MDxx compounds such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, a fast heartbeat, overheating, low blood sodium and, at worst, serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的MDxx類藥物（例如MDMA）可能造成咬牙、心跳加快、體溫過高、血鈉過低，嚴重時可能引發血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的MDxx类药物（例如MDMA）可能造成咬牙、心跳加快、体温过高、血钠过低，严重时可能引发血清素症候群。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin described it in his book PiHKAL under the nickname Ethyl-J, as part of a series built from the MDA skeleton.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中以「Ethyl-J」這個暱稱記載了它，屬於以MDA骨架衍生的一系列化合物。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中以「Ethyl-J」这个暱称记载了它，属于以MDA骨架衍生的一系列化合物。
